events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $7.06 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
RydeTAXI trip, metered fare, so distance overrun feeds the fare directly [F6][RD-2]. The trace settles one off-route segment, 09:13–09:24, 6.58 km driven where the optimal route is 1.57 km, +5.01 km [F3][RD-1]. No traffic incident qualifies: F12 records none near the route in the window, and the trace marks RD-4(a) failed — a speed band alone does not exempt [F9][F10][F11][F12][RD-4]. The driver's after-the-trip explanation of rain and congestion [F8] is a statement, not a traffic record, and RD-4 requires a traffic fact [F8][RD-4].

RD-5 turns on the rider's own words before the segment: there is no in-app chat at all [F7], and the driver's claim in his statement that the route was justified is not rider consent [F8][RD-5]. With a complete chat record and no rider message agreeing before 09:13:55, the segment counts (ground: consent_after_or_none) [F7][F8][RD-5][F3].

RD-3(a) does not apply: no rider message named any place and no stop was measured in the segment, and RD-3(b) is irrelevant because no stop was requested at all [F7][F3][RD-3].

Amount: the trace fixes the rate as this trip's distance fare ÷ distance km = $22.50 ÷ 15.96 km = $1.40977/km [F4][F6][RD-2]. The unexempted extra km is 5.01 km [F3]: 5.01 × 1.40977 = $7.0629 → $7.06. The segment's measured 5.01 km is used rather than the fare record's 5.34 km excess, since RD-2 refunds only the kilometres of unexempted segments [F3][F4][RD-2]. Waiting was $0.00 [F6], so no RD-3(c) component. RD-6 does not trigger: the driver's profile shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so no flag_account [F15][RD-6]. Safety: I read the complaint, the driver statement [F8] and the (empty) chat [F7]; the complaint asserts only the route and the extra distance, with no threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation — safety_concern none [F7][F8]. Evidence is sufficient: the off-route segment is measured [F3], the fare record supplies fare and distance [F6], and the chat record is complete and empty [F7], so every element of RD-2 and RD-5 is settled.

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We reviewed your dispute about the route taken on your RydeTAXI trip. We found one stretch where the route went well off the most direct way, and no traffic incident or other exemption covered it. You'll get $7.06 back as a Ryde voucher, covering the extra distance on that stretch. Waiting time was not charged, so nothing is added for that. Nothing else changes on your account. Thanks for flagging it.

DRIVER: We reviewed a route dispute on one of your RydeTAXI trips. The trip record shows a stretch driven well off the most direct route, and the fare is metered, so that extra distance fed straight into what the rider paid. Rain and congestion reported afterward count as an explanation, not a traffic record, and there was no message from the rider agreeing to the route beforehand. The rider is being refunded $7.06 as a Ryde voucher. This is a one-off: your account is not flagged, and no further action is taken.
